title: Design Circular Queue
description: Design a circular queue with fixed size k. Operations include enQueue, deQueue, Front, Rear, isEmpty, and isFull.
pseudocode:
1: function enQueue(value) { if(isFull()) return false; rear = (rear + 1) % size; data[rear] = value; count++; return true; }
2: function deQueue() { if(isEmpty()) return false; front = (front + 1) % size; count--; return true; }

steps.note: Enqueuing 10 into an empty circular queue of size 3.
Enqueuing 20. Rear pointer moves to index 1.
Dequeuing. Front pointer moves to index 1, effectively removing 10.
